## Hi, I'm Tiffany!

Welcome to my portfolio and corner of the internet! Here, you will get to learn about
my professional journey. This includes my professional experiences, some projects I have 
enjoyed working on, and a few fun facts about me.

I came to data science from a Public Health background. I started university interested in 
studying public health to understand how we can address the health disparities that are seen 
within our systems. However, after taking an Introduction to Data Science course, I realized 
that data science is a powerful tool. It helps us tell the stories of our communities, 
inform our decision making and bring about postive change to our systems. 

At Willamette my focus has been engaging communities with data and identifying how data can 
be used a a tool for visualization to inform decsion-making. My [capstone projects](pheal_capstone.qmd) is where 
these skills have come together for meaningful impact.

### Beyond the terminal

- 🥟 I love checking out different coffee shops, restaurants and food spots! Always open to some recommendations!
- 💬 I speak three languages! English, Chinese, Mandarin.
- 🚗 In the next two years, I am looking forward to expanding my public health, data and research skills to support positive change for our communities.
